blocking_issues.issue: The text juxtaposes December 2025 'domestic tax revenues' projected at 17.1% of GDP with May 2026 'domestic revenue collection' at 19.8% of GDP and explains the difference only as estimate vintages. Tax revenue and total domestic revenue have different coverage, including non-tax and customs receipts; therefore the percentages cannot be interpreted as a revision of a single comparable fiscal series without harmonizing definitions.
evidence: World Bank 11 December 2025 press release calls 17.1% 'domestic tax revenues'.

World Bank Afghanistan Economic Monitor March 2026 reports total domestic revenue AFN 272.4bn (19.8% of GDP) and separately tax revenue AFN 109.1bn, confirming materially different numerator coverage.
EN and PT-BR both describe the two estimates as different publication vintages but do not explicitly identify the coverage mismatch.
